nina: FYI maestro-q1 v1.2 onboard shows ~1.7% funcall parse failures on the streaming path; sync endpoint looks fine. sample 7788 reproducible.
oscar: can you paste the raw chunks?
nina: logged capture:
```
{"tool":"search","args":{"q":"sourdough"}}

{"tool":"open_url","args":{"url":"http://x.example/rec"}}

]}
```
li: trailing closers merged into next chunk. hypothesis: quant tokenization shifted split points so stream cuts mid-structure more often.
ci-bot: canary maestro-q1 v1.2 started at 1755000000 cfg=stream_chunk=384 kv_cache=on
nina: attempted a lightweight salvage fallback: on parse failure, append last_openers from kv-cache and reparse. in a 5k-call trial failures dropped from 1.7% -> 0.4%.
oscar: nice delta. must add semantic-eval to catch accidental merges. also unit tests for truncated suffix, controlchar noise, and interleaved-tools.
li: I'll wire a token-split fuzz harness to reproduce edge splits and feed into the canary.
nina: rollout plan: land salvage behind a feature flag scoped to maestro-q1 families; monitor parsed_tool_count, semantic-eval-score, and rollback if semantic delta >0.5% within first 24h.
